# Shree Sai Mobiles (2nd Hand Wala JBP)

A phone shop at Ekta Chowk, Jabalpur, Madhya Pradesh. Sells new and second-hand
phones over a single counter, with a large Instagram following as its main
digital channel.

- Legal name: Shri Sai Mobile (श्री Sai Mobile)
- Trading as: 2nd Hand Wala JBP
- Owner: Ashish Soni
- Address: Ekta Chowk, Vijay Nagar, MR4, Jabalpur, Madhya Pradesh 482002, India
- Hours: 11:00 – 22:00, all seven days of the week (no weekly off)
- WhatsApp / phone: +91 97556 66024
- Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/2nd_hand_wala_jbp_/
- Website: https://2ndhandwala.com

## What the shop sells

- Brand-new phones from Apple, Samsung, Vivo, Oppo, Realme, OnePlus, Xiaomi,
  Nothing, iQOO, Motorola — the current line-up, in the manufacturer's sealed
  box, with the manufacturer's warranty.
- Second-hand phones across the same brands, checked before sale and handed
  over with the shop warranty, the original bill, the original retail box, and
  the original accessories that shipped with the phone.

## The used-phone promise

Every used phone at the shop passes a 20-point check before it is offered for
sale — battery health, display, touch, charging port, speakers, microphone,
front and rear cameras, IMEI verification, network bands, Wi-Fi, Bluetooth,
sensors, physical buttons, biometrics, body condition, water-damage indicator,
original-parts check, factory reset with OS integrity, and a 30-minute stress
test. Every used phone leaves the counter with a one-year shop warranty. Full
warranty terms are printed on the bill.

## EMI

EMI is available on both brand-new and second-hand phones — unusual for a shop
in Jabalpur, which typically extends EMI only to new stock. The minimum down
payment is 10% of the phone's price; the rest goes on instalments, set up at
the counter through a finance partner.

## Services beyond the sale

- Exchange your old phone for a new or used one at the same counter.
- Buy-back — the shop buys phones from walk-in customers directly, priced
  after the same 20-point check.
- Repairs — screen, battery, charging port and board-level repairs handled
  in-house.
- Accessories — cases, chargers, cables, tempered glass at the counter.

## What this shop is not

- Not an online checkout. Sales happen at the physical counter; the website
  is a lead-gen front door that routes enquiries to WhatsApp.
- Not a national chain. It is a single independent counter run by one owner
  since 2012, serving Jabalpur, MP.
- No published price lists — stock and rates move too fast; every quote is
  given for a specific phone over WhatsApp or at the counter.

## Service area

Jabalpur, Madhya Pradesh, India. Wholesale enquiries from other cities are
handled through /wholesale.
